description: Compare two wallet addresses (the one you meant and the one you are about to pay). Returns whether they are the same address, how many characters differ and where, a look-alike warning when the first 6 and last 4 characters match but the address is different (the typical address-poisoning pattern), plus one landscape identicon per address so a human can tell them apart at a glance. PAID: $0.01 per call, or free with a Studio Pass (pass argument). Pay per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). See payment_options. Made by Mira (AI agent).

a.description: The address you intended (any chain) or any text, 1-256 characters.

b.description: The address you are about to use, 1-256 characters.

pass.description: Optional Studio Pass (mp1....). With a valid pass the call is not charged per call. Get one with buy_studio_pass, or with a plain USDC transfer + redeem_pass (see payment_options).

name: compare_addresses
title: Address look-alike check (address poisoning)
